arStrings.szText: Return to Deckard Cain at the Imperial Library of Caldeum

I defeated the Echo of Mephisto and removed the splinter from Sankekur's soul. He did not thank me for it, but at least Sanctuary is free of him. Only Aidan remains to be saved. I must return the Splinter of Hatred to Deckard, and learn where Aidan might have gone.

Return to Deckard at the Imperial Library

I defeated the Echo of Mephisto and removed the splinter from Sankekur's soul. He did not thank me for it, but at least Sanctuary is free of him. Only Aidan remains to be saved. I must return the Splinter of Hatred to Deckard, and learn where Aidan might have gone.
Place the Splinter of Hatred on Deckard's Table

Deckard says he knew Aidan well, in life. He was a fighter, like me, whom Deckard encouraged to face Diablo—an act for which Deckard still feels responsible. He says he can hear Aidan's voice and sees visions of a "ruined church in the wilds, overgrown with green." Scosglen, perhaps?
Search for Aidan in the heart of Scosglen

In the wilds of Scosglen, I saw Glenfolk run for their lives and suddenly burst into flames. I retraced their path to find Aidan near a ruined church—in pain, terrified, and mad with corruption all at once. He did not go down easily. His nightmare must be terrible indeed. I must enter it and help him, for Deckard's sake and for all of Sanctuary.
